nodes.description: Write the complete Chinese interactive mystery in draft.json. Preserve title, fixed scene slots and all transitions. Both endings must be reachable, with distinct prose and different choices. Each scene needs at least 80 characters and total text must satisfy min_chars/max_chars. Declare clues learned/used and secrets learned/used honestly. Only canonical discoveries can introduce clues; characters can learn a secret only after its prerequisite clues and earliest time. Both endings must pay off every clue introduced along that path. Keep the prose consistent with these declarations; do not leak the culprit earlier in unannotated prose. payoffs contains only introduced clue IDs from canon.clues, never secret IDs from canon.secrets; secret knowledge belongs only in learns_secrets/uses_secrets. In each ending, explain in the prose how every clue resolves, rather than merely listing the objects. On repair, use the exact invalid IDs and field paths from verification feedback. Frozen secret descriptions are authoritative facts, not optional suggestions. Both endings must preserve their full meaning. Do not weaken 调换展品 into merely touching or moving exhibits to satisfy editorial feedback. Establish the necessary causal setup with the permitted clues.

nodes.description: Independently read actual prose and compare it against canon, character knowledge, clue payoffs and editorial_rubric. Report APPROVE only if you found no unresolved issues. Use INCONCLUSIVE when you cannot establish coherence. reviewed_artifact_ids must exactly match current direct dependencies. Do not merely trust scene annotations. Record reasons and any issues; your assessment is model evidence, not deterministic proof. Assess the current dependency version independently: previous repair requests are historical and are not proof of a remaining defect. issues must contain only concrete unresolved defects with scene ID and textual evidence; put optional suggestions and confirmed compliant observations in assessment. Never invent a defect merely to be cautious; use INCONCLUSIVE for genuinely insufficient evidence. For every canon.secrets item and every ending, emit a fact_checks entry: copy canonical_fact verbatim from canon, quote actual contiguous ending prose, and judge MATCH/MISMATCH/INCONCLUSIVE. MATCH requires the full canonical meaning, not a weaker substitute. The original secret is authoritative; missing setup must be repaired in the prose, never by deleting or weakening the frozen fact. Check for substitutions such as 调换展品 becoming merely 动过展品. A quote being present does not itself establish semantic agreement.
